sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.description: No goals and no limits: fly whatever you like.

first_satellite.title: First satellite
first_satellite.description: Launch a craft carrying a Science satellite into Earth orbit (Route: Earth orbit). Once it has settled (held a full lap), open the mission and press Deploy satellite.

first_orbit.title: First steps
first_orbit.description: Put a crewed craft into a stable orbit around Earth.

moon_landing.title: Moon landing
moon_landing.description: Land two crew on the Moon and bring a crew home. Scored on how much of the budget is left, and whether everyone lives.

mars_base.title: Mars base
mars_base.description: Set up a Mars forward base: four crew living there with 12 months of supplies, all at the same time. Scored like the Moon landing.

terraform_mars.title: Terraform Mars
terraform_mars.description: Keep a crewed Mars base running and take Mars through all three terraforming stages: atmosphere factories on the surface, then orbital mirrors in Mars orbit, then biosphere labs. Each piece weighs 15-30 t, so plan big launchers. Scored on how fast you finish.
